today_summary: GCM26 settled $4,030.1, down $84.3 (-2.05%) on the 11 Nov session and the weakest print of the 5-day window. True max pain sits at $4,200 (+$170, +4.2% above spot) — note the scraper's max_pain field reports $5,225, which is a defect from legacy far-OTM call OI, not a real magnet. Net GEX within +/-$200 of spot is -191.9 against +79.6 across the full +/-20% window, so dealers are short gamma locally even though the wide-window sign is still positive. ATM IV 22.05% puts the 1-sigma daily move at $56 (1.39%).
five_day_thesis: The defining change over five sessions is not direction but the collapse of the gamma cushion: windowed net GEX has fallen from +305.1 on 10 Nov to +79.6 on 11 Nov (-74%), and the local +/-$200 book has gone outright short at -191.9, so the stabilizing dealer posture that absorbed the 4,070-4,115 chop for four sessions is now gone. Spot has drifted $42.8 lower across the window (4,072.9 -> 4,113.4 -> 4,074.8 -> 4,114.4 -> 4,030.1), widening the gap to the stable $4,200 pain minimum from +$127 on 5 Nov to +$170 — price has fallen away from the pin rather than the pin moving. The OI skeleton has not budged: put wall $3,700 and call wall $5,500 held all five days and P/C OI ratio printed 0.41 every session, so this is a gamma-regime shift inside a frozen structure, not a repositioning. Yesterday's flow confirms defensive intent — put/call volume ratio jumped 0.51 to 0.74, fresh puts built at $3,900 (+321) and $3,500 (+166), while the +1,353 net call OI added went to far-OTM $4,550 (+1,252) and $4,450 (+1,239) as $4,300 unwound -695, the signature of overwriting rather than conviction upside. ATM IV has firmed 1.06pp off the 20.99% low on 5 Nov to 22.05%, so premium is no longer cheapening into the weakness.

prediction: Two-sided with a long bias only above $4,100, where the local gamma dipole turns positive (+28.3 in the 4,100-4,199 bucket vs -75.6 in 4,000-4,099) and the $4,200 pain minimum starts to pull. The proximate $4,000 put wall (5,119 OI) is $30 below spot and is the level that defines the session: holding it keeps the max-pain reversion alive, losing it hands control to the -635.8 net GEX stacked below spot and opens $3,950 then the $3,900 wall. With dealers short gamma locally, treat any break as accelerative rather than mean-reverting.
